methods.name: getBookmark
methods.summary: Retrieves the current bookmark, or the nearest bookmark at or before a provided timestamp.
methods.description:
Retrieves the current bookmark, or the nearest bookmark at or before a provided
timestamp. Bookmarks can be used with the restore endpoint to revert the
database to a previous point in time.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Account identifier tag.

props.name: timestamp
props.description:
An optional ISO 8601 timestamp. If provided, returns the nearest
available bookmark at or before this timestamp. If omitted, returns the current
bookmark.

methods.name: restore
methods.summary: Restores a D1 database to a previous point in time either via a bookmark or a timestamp.
methods.description:
Restores a D1 database to a previous point in time either via a bookmark or a
timestamp.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Account identifier tag.

props.name: bookmark
props.description:
A bookmark to restore the database to. Required if `timestamp` is
not provided.

props.name: timestamp
props.description:
An ISO 8601 timestamp to restore the database to. Required if
`bookmark` is not provided.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Account identifier tag.

props.name: name
props.description: D1 database name.

props.name: jurisdiction
props.description:
Specify the location to restrict the D1 database to run and store
data. If this option is present, the location hint is ignored.

props.name: primary_location_hint
props.description:
Specify the region to create the D1 primary, if available. If this
option is omitted, the D1 will be created as close as possible to the current
user.

props.name: read_replication
mode
props.description:
The read replication mode for the database. Use 'auto' to create replicas and
allow D1 automatically place them around the world, or 'disabled' to not use any
database replicas (it can take a few hours for all replicas to be deleted).
Configuration for D1 read replication.

methods.name: export
methods.summary: Returns a URL where the SQL contents of your D1 can be downloaded.
methods.description:
Returns a URL where the SQL contents of your D1 can be downloaded. Note: this
process may take some time for larger DBs, during which your D1 will be
unavailable to serve queries. To avoid blocking your DB unnecessarily, an
in-progress export must be continually polled or will automatically cancel.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Account identifier tag.

props.name: output_format
props.description:
Specifies that you will poll this endpoint until the export
completes

props.name: current_bookmark
props.description:
To poll an in-progress export, provide the current bookmark
(returned by your first polling response)

props.name: no_data
props.description: Export only the table definitions, not their contents

props.name: no_schema
props.description: Export only each table's contents, not its definition

props.name: tables
props.description:
Filter the export to just one or more tables. Passing an empty array is the same
as not passing anything and means: export all tables.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Account identifier tag.

props.name: fields
props.description:
Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. When
omitted, all fields are returned.

methods.name: import
methods.summary: Generates a temporary URL for uploading an SQL file to, then instructing the D1 to import it and polling it for status updates.
methods.description:
Generates a temporary URL for uploading an SQL file to, then instructing the D1
to import it and polling it for status updates. Imports block the D1 for their
duration.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Account identifier tag.

props.name: action
props.description: Indicates you have a new SQL file to upload.

props.name: etag
props.description:
Required when action is 'init' or 'ingest'. An md5 hash of the file
you're uploading. Used to check if it already exists, and validate its contents
before ingesting.

props.name: filename
props.description: The filename you have successfully uploaded.

props.name: current_bookmark
props.description: This identifies the currently-running import, checking its status.
